usages.explain:
Expresses the meaning "even if unable to do A, at least must be able to do B".
This usage has an archaic tone similar to 「～ないまでも」.

examples.content: プロにはなれぬまでも、サッカーを続けていくつもりだ。
examples.transcription: ぷろにはなれぬまでも、さっかーをつづけていくつもりだ。
examples.mean: Even if I can't become a professional, I plan to continue playing soccer.

examples.content: 全額でぬまでも、せめて利子ぐらいは払ってくれ。
examples.transcription: ぜんがくでぬまでも、せめてりしぐらいははらってくれ。
examples.mean: Even if you don't pay the full amount, please at least pay the interest.

title: ぬまでも => not to say; although it does not reach the level of ~
